description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is well-trained and our facility maintains the highest standards of health and safety. You will play a key part in fostering a compliant and skilled workforce.

We are seeking a dedicated professional to manage staff education, competency assessments, and lead our infection control initiatives. This is an urgent opening for a full-time position, offering a competitive hourly rate. If you are passionate about healthcare education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or education
Experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.
